title: Deep Sea Tube Worms Reveal Ocean Secrets

scenes.text: The Mariana Trench shelters 15‑meter long tube worms.
They create calcium carbonate tubes that strengthen the trench floor.
Their tubes help stabilize the seafloor against earthquakes.
scenes.label: Seafloor Stabilizer
